name: @projexlight/sdk-persona
summary: Persona + app-identity primitives for ProjexCloud's six-layer identity model. A Person can have many app-identities (one per app); each app-identity belongs to memberships (tenant/bu) + carries role_assignments. Persona extensions let domain SDKs attach typed metadata (sales-rep quota, doctor-NPI, tech-skill-tags) without bloating the core row. Every JWT claim shape resolves through here.

endpoints.description: Create a new app-identity for a Person.
Assign a role to an app-identity within a scope.
Resolve a (person + app + tenant) tuple to the active persona for JWT signing.
User-initiated persona switch (e.g. multi-tenant operator switching contexts).
List effective permissions from role_assignments (ReBAC + ABAC reconciliation).
Offboard a persona — cascade rebac removal + audit.

Reverse role lookup: which personas hold this role template, in one tenant. Unions explicit grants with primary_role_template_id and returns each persona at most once, so a fan-out cannot double-send. tenant_id is required.

events.name: persona.app_identity.created.v1
events.description: New app-identity created for a Person.

events.name: persona.role.assigned.v1
events.description: Role assigned to an app-identity within a scope.

models.description: Resolved persona view: (app-identity, tenant, bu) pin for JWT signing.

hooks.name: createAppIdentity
hooks.description: Service entry — new app-identity for a Person; first membership often added in the same call.

hooks.name: assignRole
hooks.description: Assign a role; sdk-rebac picks up the .role.assigned.v1 event to write the underlying tuple.

hooks.name: resolvePersona
hooks.description: Given (person, app, tenant), return the persona row that signs JWTs for this session.

hooks.name: offboardPersona
hooks.description: Offboard cascade: emits .offboarded.v1; sdk-rebac + sdk-meter + sdk-data-rights react.

scenarios.title: New Person → first app-identity + tenant membership in one transaction
scenarios.when_to_use: Self-serve signup. Create Person + app-identity + membership atomically so a half-created state never exists.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Three rows + three events. sdk-rebac picks up .role.assigned.v1 to write the actual relation tuple.

scenarios.title: Multi-tenant operator switches active persona
scenarios.when_to_use: Operator works across 3 tenants; persona-switch flips the active tenant + reissues the JWT under the new persona.
scenarios.expected_outcome: New persona row resolved; JWT carries the switched tenant_id. Audit chain pins the switch.

scenarios.title: Healthcare SDK attaches doctor-NPI metadata
scenarios.when_to_use: Healthcare tenant needs NPI on every doctor persona for billing compliance; sdk-healthcare attaches as a domain extension.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Extension stored; emits .extension.changed.v1. Healthcare SDK reads on every clinical action.

scenarios.title: Persona offboard → cascade revoke across SDKs
scenarios.when_to_use: Tech leaves the company; offboardPersona emits .offboarded.v1 which sdk-rebac (revoke tuples), sdk-meter (close ledger), sdk-data-rights (DSAR prep) all react to.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Persona marked offboarded; downstream events fire in fan-out. Per-SDK cascade completion lands in the audit chain.

scenarios.title: Tenant-admin UI: list every action this persona can perform
scenarios.when_to_use: Admin reviews access — UI calls the permissions list endpoint which reconciles role_assignments via sdk-rebac.expandPermissions.
scenarios.example_code:
// GET /api/personas/:persona_id/permissions
const { permissions } = await listEffectivePermissions({ persona_id });
scenarios.expected_outcome: Array of effective permissions (action, scope, source). Useful for periodic access reviews + sudden 'who has admin' audits.

compliance_posture.notes: Six-layer JWT claim shape (sub/email/org/app/tenant/bu/parent/root/reseller) resolves through here. Offboard cascade is the SOC2 + HIPAA workforce-security implementation lever. Domain extensions let regulated verticals add typed metadata (NPI/DEA/clearance-level) without bloating the core.
